articles.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Gemini 3 Ultra with Native Video Generation
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 3 Ultra, its most capable model to date, featuring native real-time video generation and editing capabilities baked directly into the base model. The system achieves state-of-the-art benchmarks across reasoning, coding, and multimodal tasks, surpassing previous leading models from OpenAI and Anthropic. Enterprise access begins rolling out this week through Google Cloud Vertex AI.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude 4 Agents Now Autonomously Manage Multi-Week Software Projects
articles.summary: Anthropic released a major update to its Claude 4 agent framework, enabling autonomous software development agents to manage and execute multi-week coding projects with minimal human oversight. The system introduces persistent memory and a new task-decomposition architecture that allows agents to coordinate subagents across complex workflows. Early enterprise customers report a 60% reduction in developer time on large migration projects.

articles.title: OpenAI Faces EU Regulatory Probe Over GPT-5 Training Data Practices
articles.summary: The European Data Protection Board launched a formal investigation into OpenAI's data collection practices used to train GPT-5, citing potential violations of GDPR provisions around consent and data minimization. The probe follows a coalition of European publishers who allege their copyrighted content was scraped without authorization or compensation. OpenAI stated it is cooperating fully and believes its practices comply with applicable regulations.

articles.title: MIT Researchers Introduce RAG-Fusion Architecture That Cuts Hallucinations by 40%
articles.summary: A team at MIT CSAIL published a paper introducing RAG-Fusion, a new retrieval-augmented generation architecture that cross-validates retrieved documents using multiple specialized retriever models before generating a response. In benchmark evaluations across medical, legal, and financial domains, the approach reduced factual hallucinations by approximately 40% compared to standard RAG pipelines. The researchers have released the full codebase and model weights on Hugging Face.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Scout Successor with 512K Context Window
articles.summary: Meta AI released Llama 4 Edge, an open-weight model designed for on-device and edge deployment featuring a 512K token context window and optimized quantization for consumer hardware. The model runs efficiently on laptops with 16GB of unified memory, representing a significant leap in accessible long-context inference. Developers have already begun integrating it into local productivity tools and private document analysis applications.

articles.title: xAI's Grok 3 Achieves Human-Level Performance on International Math Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: Elon Musk's xAI announced that Grok 3, its latest large language model, solved 42 out of 45 problems from historical International Mathematical Olympiad exams, reaching what the company claims is human gold-medalist level performance. The achievement was independently verified by a panel of mathematics professors from Stanford and Cambridge. xAI says the model will be available to premium Grok subscribers starting June 10.

articles.title: New AI Safety Coalition Publishes Global Standards for Autonomous Agent Deployment
articles.summary: A coalition of 34 AI labs, governments, and academic institutions released a comprehensive framework for safely deploying autonomous AI agents in high-stakes environments including healthcare, infrastructure, and financial systems. The standards mandate human-in-the-loop checkpoints for irreversible actions and require independent third-party auditing for agents with access to critical systems. The framework is non-binding but has already been adopted as baseline policy by the EU AI Office and the UK's AI Safety Institute.

articles.title: Perplexity AI Launches Deep Research API for Enterprise Knowledge Management
articles.summary: Perplexity AI unveiled a new Deep Research API that allows enterprises to deploy its multi-step research agent directly within internal knowledge management systems and document repositories. The tool autonomously synthesizes insights across thousands of proprietary documents, generating structured reports with cited sources and confidence scores. The launch targets industries like consulting, pharmaceuticals, and law where rapid synthesis of large document sets is critical.
